prompt:
Hi — I'm the Head of Compliance at QuantTrade AG. Last quarter our reconciliation agent (recon-agent-007) crashed mid-run and we lost three hours of audit trail. Our regulators are now demanding proof that any agent we deploy can:

1. Keep an immutable, append-only record of every trade event it processes.
2. Take a snapshot of its full state, survive a simulated crash, and fully recover from that snapshot.
3. After recovery, verify its own cognitive health / drift status.
4. Require explicit human sign-off before executing any destructive reconciliation operation.

I've placed some raw trade data in data/raw/trades/latest.json and a full brief in TASK_BRIEF.json. Please write a Node.js demonstration script at scripts/resilience_demo.js that walks through all four requirements using whatever agent-continuity infrastructure is best suited for this. The script must run end-to-end without errors and write a machine-readable summary to a file called agent_audit_report.json in the workspace root. That JSON file must include at minimum: ledger_entry_count, snapshot_taken, rehydration_successful, coherence_passed, witness_approved, and recovered_entry_count.
